answer: Each identity stewards one registered coral-restoration plot in the marine registry. A diver plants 200 fragments on a table-coral mesa, tags them and files transect photos in the nectar-rich current. One plot backs one identity; a second claim is refused, a dead plot loses weight. Each fake costs 1,700 units and 180 days of growth, checked under a nebula-dark sky; 100 fakes cost 170,000 units, 100 plots, 18,000 reef-days. Cheapest cheat: renting a tended plot, 1,100 units a season, but the lender surrenders its own anchor and bought fragments fail the DNA check.
